decision: Add four tenant-isolated FORCE-RLS tables in a single migration 034_budget_schema.sql — instance_budget, agent_budget, reservation, spend_ledger — following the T-0013 isolation pattern exactly (tenant_id leading PK, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, default-DENY policy USING (tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid), choros_app non-owner grants). spend_ledger is append-only via the T-0016 audit_event pattern verbatim: SELECT/INSERT-only grant + BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE trigger raising restrict_violation for all roles. Two-ceiling AND-gate and reserve->finalize/release lifecycle are encoded as DDL constraints (CHECK held>0/ceiling>0/amount>0, status CHECK, at-least-one-budget CHECK, UNIQUE(tenant_id,tool_call_id), composite tenant-leading FKs); the AND-gate decrement and TTL auto-release are NOT triggers (they are E5.9 Stage-2 runtime, FR-10) — day-1 the schema only makes them expressible, balance reconstructable from spend_ledger + open reservations (FR-7), remaining_cache is advisory with no constraint. agent_card.budget_policy_id -> instance_budget(tenant_id,id) FK (named agent_card_budget_policy_fk) added in the same migration behind an IF EXISTS agent_card + NOT EXISTS conname guard. Slot 035 left reserved/unused. No TypeScript ships (NF-5); tables dormant day-1 (FR-10/AC-23). Full DDL live-validated against the silo Postgres (migrations 001-032 incl. 032_agent_card applied) in a ROLLBACK probe: all tables/RLS/policies/grants/trigger/FK/seed applied; AC-7 update rejected, AC-10 held=0 rejected, AC-16 0.000001 retained, AC-20 fk=1.

rejected_alternatives.option: AND-gate decrement + balance enforcement as a DB trigger on reservation INSERT
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Violates FR-10 (no day-1 runtime enforcement) and prejudges the E5.9 atomicity design (lock strategy is E5.9's call). FR-7 reconstruction + CHECK constraints make the invariant expressible; enforcing it is Stage-2. Schema, not behaviour, is day-1.

rejected_alternatives.option: remaining_cache maintained by trigger to equal ledger - open reservations exactly
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Spec makes the cache advisory and reconstructable (FR-7); a maintaining trigger is the runtime enforcement FR-10 defers and couples the cache to a specific TTL-sweep policy owned by E5.9. Cache is a plain column updated by the future finalize/release transaction.

rejected_alternatives.option: Two migration files (034 tables, 035 FK seam)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: The grant_role_fk precedent (021) split a deferred FK only because its target (role) was created in a different migration (019). Here instance_budget is created in the same file as the FK targeting it and run.mjs applies one file per transaction — splitting buys nothing. One file (034); 035 reserved.

A Postgres ENUM is a schema object needing CREATE TYPE and a migration to extend; text + CHECK is the codebase convention (employee.kind, migration 016) and keeps additions to a one-line CHECK change.

rejected_alternatives.option: spend_ledger as a hash-chained log like audit_event (prev_hash/row_hash)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: audit_event hash-chains because it is the tamper-evident audit floor (T-0016). spend_ledger append-only via trigger is the ratified requirement (FR-4/NF-1); hash-chaining is unrequested scope.

rejected_alternatives.option: Surrogate single-column PK id with separate tenant_id column
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Violates T-0013: tenant_id MUST be the leading PK column. PK is (tenant_id, id) on all four tables.

rejected_alternatives.option: Single-column FKs (id only) from reservation/spend_ledger to budget tables
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Tenant-scoped composite FKs (tenant_id, x_id) -> (tenant_id, id) are the T-0013/NF-2 rule (leading tenant_id on every FK; cross-tenant references rejected). Single-column FK would let tenant A reference a tenant B budget. All FKs are composite, tenant-leading.

contracts: Migration 034_budget_schema.sql: single file, one transaction (run.mjs). Order: CREATE instance_budget -> agent_budget (FK employee) -> reservation (FK instance_budget, agent_budget) -> spend_ledger (FK reservation, employee, instance_budget, agent_budget). Each table: PK (tenant_id, id); ENABLE+FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; POLICY <table>_tenant_isolation USING/WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid).

spend_ledger append-only: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION choros.spend_ledger_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql RAISE EXCEPTION 'spend_ledger is append-only: % is forbidden', TG_OP USING ERRCODE='restrict_violation'; BEFORE UPDATE trigger spend_ledger_no_update; BEFORE DELETE trigger spend_ledger_no_delete; GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON choros.spend_ledger TO choros_app (NO UPDATE/DELETE). Mirrors migrations/006_audit_event.sql.
Grants: instance_budget/agent_budget/reservation = SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE TO choros_app; spend_ledger = SELECT,INSERT only.

Constraints: instance_budget_ceiling_positive CHECK(ceiling>0); agent_budget_ceiling_positive CHECK(ceiling>0); agent_budget_window_kind_chk CHECK(window_kind IN ('instance','daily','monthly','total')); reservation_held_positive CHECK(held>0); reservation_status_chk CHECK(status IN ('open','spent','released')); reservation_at_least_one_budget CHECK(instance_budget_id IS NOT NULL OR agent_budget_id IS NOT NULL); spend_ledger_amount_positive CHECK(amount>0); UNIQUE(tenant_id, tool_call_id) on reservation. All amount columns numeric(18,6).

agent_card FK seam: DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (information_schema.tables agent_card) AND NOT EXISTS (pg_constraint conname='agent_card_budget_policy_fk') THEN ALTER TABLE choros.agent_card ADD CONSTRAINT agent_card_budget_policy_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, budget_policy_id) REFERENCES choros.instance_budget(tenant_id, id); END IF; END $$;

ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt += instance_budget, agent_budget, reservation, spend_ledger (append at end; file is unordered append-list; AC-18 set requirement, not file ordering). Consuming tests iterate the set order-independently.

C-1 E5.9 runtime contract: reserve = INSERT reservation(status='open', held=max_cost, expires_at) after an atomic AND-gate min(instance_remaining, agent_remaining) >= max_cost (E5.9 owns atomicity mechanism); duplicate tool_call_id -> 23505, caller reads existing; finalize-spend = UPDATE status='spent' + INSERT spend_ledger(amount<=held); finalize-release = UPDATE status='released', no ledger row; balance via FR-7 reconstruction; E5.9 enforces NF-3 currency homogeneity (no day-1 DB check).
C-2 T-0020: instance_budget(tenant_id, id) is FK target for agent_card.budget_policy_id; FK named agent_card_budget_policy_fk; column stays nullable; no runtime consumption day-1.
C-3 future budget-admin API: four table shapes are the stable surface; column semantics change only via new migration + spec amendment.
